    • Method Detail

      • isSet

        default boolean isSet​(int i)
        Whether the ith value has been set.
        Throws:
        IndexOutOfBoundsException - if the index is invalid.

      • isSet

        default boolean isSet​(@NonNull
                      CqlIdentifier id)
        Whether the value for the first occurrence of id has been set.

        If you want to avoid the overhead of building a CqlIdentifier, use the variant of this method that takes a string argument.

        Throws:
        IndexOutOfBoundsException - if the id is invalid.

      • isSet

        default boolean isSet​(@NonNull
                      String name)
        Whether the value for the first occurrence of name has been set.

        This method deals with case sensitivity in the way explained in the documentation of AccessibleByName.

        Throws:
        IndexOutOfBoundsException - if the name is invalid.

      • unset

        @NonNull
@CheckReturnValue
default SelfT unset​(int i)
        Unsets the ith value. This will leave the statement in the same state as if no setter was ever called for this value.
        Throws:
        IndexOutOfBoundsException - if the index is invalid.

      • unset

        @NonNull
@CheckReturnValue
default SelfT unset​(@NonNull
                    CqlIdentifier id)
        Unsets the value for the first occurrence of id. This will leave the statement in the same state as if no setter was ever called for this value.
        Throws:
        IndexOutOfBoundsException - if the id is invalid.

      • unset

        @NonNull
@CheckReturnValue
default SelfT unset​(@NonNull

        Unsets the value for the first occurrence of name. This will leave the statement in the same state as if no setter was ever called for this value.
